translation_notes: Five literal SPARQL SELECT strings, one with no initBindings (translated as a plain `s{ }(g)`) and four with `initBindings={'cmc': cmc}` where `?cmc` is a join-only variable never in the SELECT list: per the strata rule for `bind_initbindings` with a non-projected variable, each `?cmc` occurrence in the pattern becomes a term interpolation `{cmc}` rather than `s{ }(bindings=...)`.

No `@prefix` was needed: the queries use only bare `rdf:` (bound by rdflib's/ldpy's built-in default namespaces) and full opaque IRIs written literally as `<pyj:CMC>` etc. (scheme `pyj`, not a namespace prefix) -- there is no PREFIX clause to inherit as a prologue in this region.

Corrected `oracle` from the pipeline's `isomorphism` to `values`: the function only reads `g` and returns a dot-source string built from `.query()` results and `print()`/f-strings; nothing here builds or mutates an RDF graph, so the driver compares the returned string (design record corpus/405) via a Turtle fixture rather than graph isomorphism.

fixture.ttl: two `pyj:CMC` clusters covering both branches of the `cmc_label != "none"` subgraph-wrapper test, each with a dataframe/method/call/return match for every query; the method-call/method-call-arg property-path alternation is exercised on different cmcs; a stray dataframe+method pair tagged with a `pyj:cmc` value that is itself never typed `pyj:CMC` checks that untyped cmcs do not leak into the loop; a second call with an empty graph covers the zero-solution `cmcs == []` case.
Deliberately broke `translated.ldpy` (retyped one `<pyj:Method>` to `<pyj:MethodX>`) and confirmed `rdfeval check` turns FAIL with a KeyError from the now-missing node -- not a hollow green.

Reviewed 2026-11-02 (PI decision: m{ } for any BGP): four of the five queries are pure basic graph patterns without DISTINCT (same multiplicity) and are now m{ }; their rows are unpacked as before (two or three projected variables yield tuples, in order of first appearance). The cmc-bound ones interpolate `{cmc}` in object position. m{ } needs `rdf:` declared, which s{ } got from rdflib's default bindings, so `@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .` was added. The fourth query (method-call edges) stays s{ } because of the property-path alternation `<pyj:method-call>|<pyj:method-call-arg>`, which m{ } does not express.
